Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about our products, policies, and services

📝 Age Requirements & Verification

What is the legal age to purchase tobacco and vaping products in Quebec? ›

You must be at least 18 years old to purchase tobacco and vaping products in Quebec. This is mandated by provincial law and strictly enforced at all times.

What forms of ID do you accept? ›

We accept government-issued photo identification including: Quebec driver's license, Canadian passport, Canadian citizenship card, Permanent Resident card, provincial ID card, or foreign passport. The ID must be current and not expired.

Do I need to show ID every time I visit? ›

Yes. We are required by law to verify age for every tobacco and vaping product transaction, even for regular customers. This ensures compliance and protects both you and our business.

🛍️ Products & Inventory

Are all products authentic and not counterfeit? ›

Absolutely. We only source products from authorized distributors and manufacturers. All products come with proper authentication and we guarantee 100% authenticity.

How can I check if a product is in stock? ›

Call us at (450) 290-0340 during business hours and our staff will be happy to check inventory for you. You can also ask during your drive-through visit.

Do you carry devices for beginners? ›

Yes! We carry a wide range of devices suitable for all experience levels. Our staff can recommend beginner-friendly devices and help you choose the right nicotine strength and flavors.

💳 Payment & Pricing

What payment methods do you accept? ›

We accept cash, debit cards (Interac), and all major credit cards including Visa, Mastercard, and American Express.

Are prices online the same as in-store? ›

Prices listed on our website are accurate at the time of posting but may be subject to change. For the most current pricing, please call us or visit in person.

Do you offer price matching? ›

We strive to offer competitive prices. While we don't have a formal price matching policy, please speak with our staff if you have concerns about pricing.

↩️ Returns & Refunds

What is your return policy? ›

Due to health and safety regulations, we cannot accept returns on opened vaping or tobacco products. Unopened products may be returned within 7 days with original receipt. Defective devices may be exchanged within 14 days.

What if I receive a defective product? ›

If you receive a defective product, bring it back with your receipt within 14 days and we will exchange it for a new one or provide a full refund. Manufacturer warranties may also apply to certain devices.

Can I exchange a flavor I don't like? ›

Unfortunately, once e-liquid or pod products are opened, they cannot be returned or exchanged for health and safety reasons. We recommend trying smaller sizes or sample packs when trying new flavors.

🚗 Drive-Thru Service

How does the drive-through work? ›

Simply drive up to our window, show your ID, place your order with our staff, pay, and receive your products—all without leaving your vehicle! See our How It Works page for details.

Is there a wait time? ›

Most orders are completed in just a few minutes. Wait times may vary during peak hours, but we work hard to keep service fast and efficient.

Can I walk in or do I have to use the drive-through? ›

We primarily operate as a drive-through for convenience and safety, but walk-in service may be available during certain hours. Please call ahead to confirm.

🏥 Health & Safety

Are vaping products safer than cigarettes? ›

According to Health Canada, while vaping is generally considered less harmful than smoking cigarettes, it is not risk-free. Vaping products contain nicotine, which is highly addictive. We recommend consulting health professionals for personal advice.

Is nicotine addictive? ›

Yes. Nicotine is a highly addictive chemical. Health Canada warns that nicotine can harm adolescent brain development and create dependence. Products should only be used by adults 18+ who are already smokers or vapers.

Still Have Questions?

Our friendly staff are here to help. Contact us anytime!
